name: cryoet-skills
description: Claude Code skills for cryo-ET subtomogram averaging on any Slurm HPC or workstation: WarpTools preprocessing, TeamTomo, RELION 5 refinement, M multi-particle refinement, tomoDRGN heterogeneity and ChimeraX figures, with a cryoet-workflow director that sets up a per-user config and runs the stages your site has installed.
